name: BlendedMVS
description: A multi-view stereo dataset with 113 scenes and about 17k views. This record is loader-only and does not vendor dataset data.
citation: BlendedMVS: A Large-scale Dataset for Generalized Multi-view Stereo Networks. Yao et al., Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2020.
